title: Void Eclipse
description:
Turn-based strategy and an immersive sci-fi story which blends card battle tactics with 4X grand strategy.

Engage in an epic campaign across the galaxy, unlocking new units along the way. 

Tactical turn-based combat with many passive and active battle abilities!

Choose which missions to take, what questions to ask, and what kind of personality traits to unlock.

A gritty sci-fi tale, full of choices You're an android with scattered memories in search of your mysterious origins. Explore the stars, Evolve your army and Fight an alien threat. Choose to help characters or harm them - will you be Feared, Admired, or Respected?
description_short: Void Eclipse is turn-based strategy in an immersive sci-fi world, blending card battle tactics with 4X grand strategy. Explore the stars, Evolve your army and Fight an alien threat. Help characters or harm them - will you be Feared, Admired, or Respected?
